summary.result: The suggested regression equation was quite well predicted the depth of replacement and recommended to use under certain restrictions where the embankment height was less than 10m and under 0.2 kgf/cm^{2} of the undrained shear strength of soil.
summary.background: The research has been done to obtain a empirical equation for the depth of replacement by the analysis of data collected from 8 sea-dike construction sites of south coast of Korean peninsula.
summary.method: The correlation analysis results show that the depth of replacement was mainly dependent upon the height of embankment and the undrained shear strength of soft soil.

summary_ko.method: 상관분석 결과에 따르면 치환심도는 제방높이와 약한 토양의 비침투 전단강도에 주로 의존하였다.
